tool_schemas.name: list_icons
tool_schemas.description: Lists Hugeicons in the catalog and returns a cursor-paged result set filtered by status, category, style, and/or version_introduced, sorted by the requested field and order; include cursor to fetch the next page and limit (1–200) to cap the number of icons returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, sort/order/status is not one of the supported values, or cursor is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to browse the catalog, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate limits are exceeded.

version_introduced.description: Filter icons introduced in a specific version (e.g. '2.1.0')

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results

limit.description: Maximum number of icons to return

tool_schemas.name: search_icons
tool_schemas.description: Searches the icon catalog by name and tags using the provided query string (comma-separated terms are treated as multiple searches) and returns matching icons. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/empty or exceeds allowed input constraints. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller is not permitted to search, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request rate limits are exceeded.

query.description: Search query to find relevant icons. Separate multiple searches with commas

tool_schemas.name: get_platform_usage
tool_schemas.description: Returns the installation and usage guide for Hugeicons for the requested platform (react, vue, angular, svelte, react-native, flutter). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if platform is not one of the supported values. Raises NOT_FOUND when no usage guide exists for the specified platform, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or QUOTA_EXCEEDED when access is denied or rate limits are exceeded.

platform.description: Platform name (react, vue, angular, svelte, react-native, flutter)

tool_schemas.name: get_icon
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single icon by id and returns its full catalog record. Returns NOT_FOUND if no icon exists for the given id, and FORBIDDEN if the icon is hidden (hidden icons are not exposed on this surface). Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or QUOTA_EXCEEDED when access is denied or rate limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: list_tags
tool_schemas.description: Lists tags in the catalog and returns a cursor-paged result set filtered by status and/or name prefix, sorted by the requested field and order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, sort/order/status is unsupported, or cursor is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or QUOTA_EXCEEDED when access is denied or rate limits are exceeded.

name_prefix.description: Filter tags whose name starts with this prefix (case-insensitive)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results

limit.description: Maximum number of tags to return

tool_schemas.name: list_icon_aliases
tool_schemas.description: Lists icon aliases and returns a cursor-paged result set filtered by icon_id and/or status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range, sort/order/status is unsupported, or cursor is malformed. Raises NOT_FOUND when icon_id is provided but does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN or QUOTA_EXCEEDED when access is denied or rate limits are exceeded.

icon_id.description: Filter aliases belonging to a specific icon id

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results

limit.description: Maximum number of aliases to return

tool_schemas.name: update_icon_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions an icon between lifecycle states by updating its status. Enforces allowed transitions: active→deprecated|hidden, deprecated→active|hidden, hidden→active. Returns the updated icon record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the icon does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if the transition is not allowed, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to change publication state. Raises UNAUTHORIZED or QUOTA_EXCEEDED when access is denied or rate limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: update_icon_alias_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions an icon alias between lifecycle states by updating its status (active↔disabled). Returns the updated alias record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the alias does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if the transition is not allowed, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to change alias state. Raises UNAUTHORIZED or QUOTA_EXCEEDED when access is denied or rate limits are exceeded.

metadata.name: Hugeicons MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores the Hugeicons icon catalog (icons, tags, aliases) and platform-specific usage guides. Primary workflows are listing and searching icons by name/tags, and retrieving installation/usage instructions for a given frontend/mobile platform. Repository: https://github.com/hugeicons/mcp-
